MEET YOUR NEW CAMERA COACH

A good photo.
One move at a time.

  1. 01

    Let us see the moment.

    Start your camera and allow access. Frame one person at a time. On iPhone, open FRAME in Safari.

  2. 02

    Find your frame and pose.

    Choose Travel, Full body, or Portrait. Pick a pose, then follow the arrow from your current position to the target. The guide tells you who should move and by how much. Tap Set cm / m, enter the person’s height and current camera distance, then calibrate with the entire person visible. The guide estimates sideways and forward/back movement in cm and m.

  3. 03

    Keep the good ones.

    The camera opens in a shooting view. Tap Options for pose packs and Best of 3; Compose suggests framing from the background. Best of 3 saves all three candidates and highlights a pick. Auto capture also waits for open eyes and a steady frame when Best of 3 is on.

For an app-like experience on iPhone, open Safari → Share → Add to Home Screen.
The pose coach may take a moment to load the first time.
PRIVATE BY DESIGN

Your photos.
Your space.

Camera frames and imported photos are analyzed on this device. They are not uploaded or sent to an external AI service.

Your gallery is stored locally. Clearing app or browser data may remove photos, so export the ones you want to keep.

This beta guides one person using position, framing, and the selected pose. Metric guidance is estimated from the height and distance you enter; there is no depth sensor measurement. Composition suggestions use visible brightness and background edges. Blink and sharpness checks run locally too; these checks do not rate beauty or identify people.
